description:
List the people behind a many-people pin or an approximate-area pin.

    Returns: { total, page, perPage, totalPages, kind: 'address' | 'area', named,
    members: [ { id, addressType, label, housingStatus, hasPhoto } ] }. Members
    carry `label` only when the group id came from a view at zoom 15 or closer
    (`named: true`). Each member `id` opens with map_open_record.

    Billing: one map request per page. A group id works for 24 hours and only
    for the account it was issued to; after that, call map_viewport again.

    Auth: uses the caller's X-API-Key (request header or OFFENDERSEARCH_API_KEY env).

group_id.description: A `groupId` ('mg_...') from a map_viewport, map_area or map_route marker with `id: null`, from a map_route `groups` entry, or from an entry in `areas` / `approximate.areas`.
group_id.title: Group Id
